name: search-doctor
description: Stops grep habits from silently breaking Claude Code's searches. Fixes rg commands written with grep flags before they run (rg -rn replaces every match with the letter n), and when a Grep or grep search finds nothing because its pattern is in the wrong regex dialect (\| in ripgrep, a|b in basic grep, \d in grep), tells Claude the empty result may be the pattern, not the code.
